notes: IUP catalog program pages (catalog.iup.edu preview_program) returned empty responses to every fetch and the department's checklist PDFs now return Page Not Found. The frame courses come from search-result excerpts of the IUP program checklist and catalog, so course numbers are not confirmed against the current catalog page. Every catalog_url points to the IUP catalog entry for COSC 110 (the one catalog page that loaded), not to a page for that course, and program.requirements_url is the Software Engineering track page found in search. IUP has three BS tracks (Software Engineering, Languages and Systems, Cyber Security); the Software Engineering track was used because it carries COSC 319. No public syllabus was found for any frame course.
